get_points_world: extract world-space 3D points and distance standard deviations from an ARIA batch using depth images or ground truth points
get_freespace_world: compute free-space sample points along camera rays within a voxel grid for a given batch snippet
collapse_pointcloud_time: flatten a time-series point cloud tensor into a unique set of 3D points by removing NaNs and duplicates
pointcloud_to_voxel_ids: convert a point cloud in voxel grid coordinates into discrete voxel IDs with a validity mask for in-bounds points
pointcloud_to_occupancy_snippet: build an occupancy grid and visibility mask from a point cloud by marking occupied voxels and sampling free-space along rays
